title: CMS-Driven Websites & Components
summary: Editor-friendly websites where content lives in a CMS, not in code.
problem: Marketing teams needed to change pages, media and forms without a developer for every edit.
solution: Integrated headless-CMS content into React interfaces, built reusable WordPress block components and responsive layouts, and responsive HTML emails that render in Gmail and Outlook.
result: Content, media and forms are managed by editors, with cross-device QA on every component.
